jobs.title: Environmental Field Scientist/Geologist/Engineer- Idaho
jobs.description:
Job Description

Bring your curiosity and determination to make a positive impact on the future of mining!Together and with our mining clients, we will create a lasting community benefit making water, energy, and communities sustainable for generations to come.

Be a field engineer delivering environmental compliance services to a key mining client.Work on an exciting mining infrastructure project in the Western U.S. Showcase your technical capabilities and expertise.

Join GHD.

Who are we looking for?

GHD’s U.S West Mining Team is seeking a highly-motivated Field Environmental/Scientist/Engineer
to join our Mining Team and provide full-time field environmental compliance monitoring for a major mine infrastructure construction project.

This position will be located onsite in Idaho, with a work schedule of 14 days on site, 7 days off, 10-12 hour rotational shifts. Straight time-overtime will be paid, as well as on-site accommodations provided, meals and daily per diem. Candidates living outside of Idaho will be considered, travel accommodations provided. Visa sponsorship is not an option.

This position will be embedded with the construction team and serve as the primary field resource for ensuring construction activities are conducted in compliance with environmental permits, regulatory requirements, project commitments, and client standards.

The successful candidate will work closely with project managers, contractors, environmental specialists, and safety professionals to support environmentally responsible construction practices while maintaining a strong safety culture.

This role is well suited for a hands-on professional who enjoys working in dynamic field environments, collaborating with multi-disciplinary teams, and supporting the successful delivery of large-scale mining and infrastructure projects.

Join an employee-owned firm that will invest in your growth and development. GHD is the place for aspiring people like you to thrive, achieve your career goals, and make a lasting impact.

Working with an energetic and high performing team, this position offers a variety of work and will see you involved in:

Environmental Compliance Monitoring
Dust and Air Quality Monitoring
Noise Monitoring
Stormwater Management and Erosion Control
Water Quality Monitoring
Waste and Hazardous Materials Management
Documentation and Reporting

Health And Safety Responsibilities

Lead and participate in daily tailgate safety meetings and pre-task planning sessions.
Participate in Field Operations Reviews (FORs), site inspections, and safety audits.
Complete Pre-Work Assessments and support Job Safety and Environmental Analysis (JSEA) Assessments and hazard assessments for field activities.
Promote a strong safety culture through active engagement with project staff and contractors.
Identify, document, and communicate potential safety hazards and environmental risks.
Ensure all work activities are performed in accordance with company health, safety, and environmental procedures.
Participate in incident investigations, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Serve as a visible safety leader in the field and demonstrate a commitment to Goal Zero performance.

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, environmental science, or a closely related field

Qualifications:

Minimum 3 years of technical experience supporting environmental compliance, construction monitoring, infrastructure projects, or related environmental programs.
Ability to fulfill a work schedule of 14 days on site, 7 days off, 10-12 hour rotational shifts in Idaho
Experience conducting field inspections and environmental monitoring activities
Knowledge of dust control, stormwater management, erosion and sediment control practices, water quality monitoring, and environmental permitting/compliance requirements is required
Strong documentation skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and electronic field data collection tools.
Valid driver’s license with a satisfactory driving record.
Experience supporting remote mining, water management, and/or large-scale earthworks construction projects preferred.
MSHA training, OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety certification, or equivalent strongly desired
Ability and willingness to travel and work remotely in a full-time, field-based role

Physical Requirements

Ability to work outdoors for extended periods in varying weather conditions.
Ability to traverse uneven terrain and active construction sites.
Ability to stand, walk, climb, and conduct field inspections throughout the workday.
Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including hard hats, safety boots, high-visibility clothing, safety glasses, and other site-specific PPE.
Ability to lift and carry equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.

As a multicultural organization, we encourage individual achievement and recognize the strength of a diverse workforce. GHD is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, marital status or veteran status.

Benefits

401K - Employees are eligible to participate on the first day of the month following 3 months of service
Paid time off – Our PTO benefit is designed to provide eligible employees with a period of rest and relaxation, sick, and personal time throughout the year. PTO starts at 16 days per year and increases with years of service
Holiday Pay - Holiday pay is provided for eligible employees. GHD observes 9 holidays per year. Holiday pay will be based on the regular set schedule for the employee
Wellness Benefit- Regular full-term employees are eligible to participate in the wellness reimbursement program. GHD will reimburse 50% of the cost of the following to maximum of $250.00 reimbursement annually for such items as: Health club membership fees, Home exercise equipment purchases, Bicycles, Race, run & marathon entrance fees, Smoking cessation programs, Weight loss programs (i.e.—Weight Watchers, Jenny Craig), Fitbits and Fitness Tracking devices

Salary: $85,000-$145,000 based on experience

jobs.description:
Job Title: Distribution & Construction Project Coordinator

Duration: 24 Months

Location: San Diego, CA/Hybrid

Pay Rate: $41.30/hr

Position Summary:

Acts as primary coordinator over the GTS Inspection & Maintenance program throughout the service territory for gas system assets. Validates and updates critical maintenance and inspection work record data. Creates, monitors, and manages work orders and maintenance notifications of company assets and equipment records in SAP-PM to ensure successful completion of necessary field repairs. Monitors the status of field work orders for completion, required follow-up, work scope changes, joint meet requirements, and access issues.
Responds to data requests from the management and Compliance departments for internal and external audits. Creates and modifies ad-hoc and standardized reports using HANA and SAP-PM systems to ensure compliance, monitor notifications, and monitor work order status for Gas Technical Services. Assists with technical system support questions for represented personnel, sometimes resulting in scheduled work modifications for represented personnel. May assist supervisor with special project reporting and analysis.
Performs Pipeline and Liquified Natural Gas (Client) emergency response functions by dispatching and assigning represented personnel via CLICK system, including phone notification, other department coordination, and order creation/ processing (creation, modification, and management through completion of trouble orders in SAP-PM). Acts as a liaison with various internal and external departments. Interacts daily with represented field personnel regarding order completion status, CLICK issues, and additional crew support as needed (assist crews and/ or extra equipment needed, material ordering, etc).
Performs other duties as assigned which include but are not limited to assisting ARSO scheduling with compliance inspection and maintenance orders, creating and modifying late lists and prearranged lists, updating vacation information, and ensuring callout lists with qualifications are accurate.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Us

PAR Western Line Contractors, LLC (dba QUES), a subsidiary of Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE: PWR), is composed of some of the most highly qualified professionals experienced in all aspects of engineering, designing, asset management, and construction management for the electric utility and other industries. We are a highly mobile and flexible team with the ability to service every area and region within our customers’ area of operation. With over 700 employees and growing, we have thousands of years of combined electrical utility experience to draw from when committing to provide our clients with a wide range of utility services.

About This Role

Project Coordinators handle administrative tasks for the project manager and team members to keep the project running smoothly. This may include ordering equipment and supplies, managing deadlines and workflow, and scheduling meetings and appointments.

What You'll Do

Works with a team of Project Coordinators to ensure administrative activities are completed for the division
Supports department with timecards, materials tracking, mark for locates, daily reports, scheduling, cost control, change-order tracking, vendor and subcontractor tracking, client billing, and pay invoices
Assists the project team with the preparation of bid documentation and helps to prepare for bid reviews
Meets work standards by following productivity, quality, and customer-service standards, resolving operational problems, and identifying work process improvements as necessary
Helps meet cost standards by monitoring expenses and implementing cost-saving actions
Updates job knowledge by going to the field, participating in educational opportunities, and getting to know/understand the division.
Enhances department and organization reputation by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests and exploring opportunities to add value to job accomplishments.
Other related duties and projects as assigned

What You'll Bring

Associates or bachelor's preferred, not required
1-2 years of experience in a project coordinator role or related field
Excellent communication skills
Reasoning ability, including problem-solving and analytical skills
Microsoft Office and Outlook Email
Time Management and project management skills
Travel requirements to job sites as needed
Must be able to maintain a valid driver's license if traveling.

Ability to work extended hours when necessary for business needs
Experience working in construction is a plus
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment

Supervisory Responsibilities

None

Physical Requirements

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.

What You'll Get

Pay- $ 26.00 - $ 30.00 /Hourly *Depending on Experience

Benefits include-- Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K

If you’re dependable, enjoy working outdoors, and want a stable career with purpose, this could be a great fit.

These are full time positions, with occasional overtime and weekend work. No experience? No problem. We provide paid training with an instructor.

As a Leak Survey Technician, you play a vital role in protecting life, property, and the environment. You will inspect natural gas systems, detect potential leaks using advanced equipment, and ensure compliance with safety regulations. Your work directly supports public safety and environmental protection in the communities we serve.

O
ur Values

Walk approximately 4–7 miles per day
Bend, kneel, and lift up to 25 pounds
Work in various weather conditions
Remain on your feet for extended periods

You will use industry-leading gas detection technology to identify potential leaks. Heath provides comprehensive paid training and certifications to ensure you are fully prepared and confident in the field.

Strong reliability and accountability
Customer service experience preferred, but not required
Ability to use Simple Hand Tools

Ability to use and understand utility maps

No industry experience is necessary
— we value work ethic, dependability, and a safety-first mindset.

Action Oriented / Demonstrates Ability to Take Initiative
Customer Focused / Customer Oriented
Makes good Decisions with Quality Problem Solving / Demonstrates Good Judgment
Results Oriented / Achiever
Functional / Technical Skills / Technically Competent
Demonstrates integrity and Trustworthy
Detail Oriented
Good at Prioritizing & Communicating
Time Management Skills

Benefits

Weekly pay
Paid training and industry certifications
401(k) with company match
Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
Paid time off and paid holidays
$1,500 employee referral bonus
Monthly phone allowance up to $40.00

Career Growth

Many of our technicians advance into senior technician, field leadership, and safety management roles. Heath is committed to developing long-term careers, not just filling positions.

If you are dependable, safety-minded, and ready to build a career that makes a difference, we encourage you to apply.

About The Company

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.

In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.

Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.

Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.

Our Company Values Guide Our Daily Actions

Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.

STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.

Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.

Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.

The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.

Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

Analyze Ontology structures to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for optimization
Provide analytical support for Ontology changes, including upstream inputs and downstream dependencies
Implementation of Search data enhancements
Develop repeatable analyses to validate data integrity and configuration accuracy
Analyze search behavior, query patterns, and user interaction data to identify opportunities to improve search relevance and accuracy
Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights for business and technical stakeholders
Establish and maintain data quality checks for Ontology and search data
Support documentation and standardization of analytical methodologies

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

5+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in healthcare, insurance or digital product environments
5+ years of experience with data modeling concepts
5+ years of experience using SQL and relational databases
5+ years of experience with Python or R for data analysis
3+ years of demonstrated experience working with healthcare administrative data (e.g. claims, encounter, clinical, provider etc.)
Demonstrated working knowledge of clinical data domains, code sets and ontologies (e.g. ICD, SNOMED, RxNorm)
Willing and able to travel 10% +/- depending on business need

Preferred Qualifications

1+ year experience with cloud computing (AWS, Azure) and data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake
Experience working with search platforms, search analytics, or relevance tuning
Experience presenting research methods and findings to stakeholders
Familiarity with taxonomy
Proven exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects in a highly dynamic environment
Proven high attention to detail
Proven innate curiosity to learn more

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a leading integrated manufacturing solutions provider serving the fastest-growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. Recognized as a technology leader, Sanmina Corporation provides end-to-end manufacturing solutions, delivering superior quality and support to Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) primarily in the communications networks, defense and aerospace, industrial and semiconductor systems, medical, multimedia, computing and storage, automotive and clean technology sectors. Sanmina Corporation has facilities strategically located in key regions throughout the world.

Industrial Engineer/Project Coordinator

Job Purpose

Our Houston facility is looking for a practical, highly organized Industrial Engineer / Project Coordinator
to join our team during a major plant expansion. In this role, you will work directly with our Facilities Manager to coordinate equipment installations, track project timelines, and manage vendor schedules.

Because we are expanding, you will also act as a flexible engineering resource to help our Process and Manufacturing Engineers when workloads are high. Beyond physical facility coordination, this role focuses heavily on data analysis—tracking manufacturing costs, calculating floor efficiency, and identifying operational waste. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in facility planning, factory software systems, financial tracking, and project management.

Nature Of Duties

Track Equipment Installations: Work directly with equipment suppliers and contractors on the plant floor. Monitor delivery schedules, ensure utilities (power, air, etc.) are ready for setup, and track installation progress.
Manage Factory Software & Data: Use Oracle ERP and our Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to enter production routes, audit labor hours, and keep our manufacturing data accurate.
Conduct Time Studies & Costing: Spend time on the production floor timing assembly steps to compute cycle times. Use this data to help accounting establish accurate standard labor and machine costs.
Track Waste & Rework Costs: Collect and analyze data on scrap rates, material waste, and rework labor hours. Investigate the root causes of these variances to help the team reduce lost profitability on the floor.
Analyze Equipment Downtime & Capacity: Monitor machine utilization metrics through the MES. Categorize why machines stop (maintenance delays, slow setups, or waiting on parts) to help improve overall capacity.
Map Workflows & Material Flow: Create clear process flowcharts and value stream maps (VSM) using Microsoft Visio. Analyze material handling paths and operator travel times to minimize transit costs and prevent product damage.
Create Status Reports & Decks: Gather project updates, capacity metrics, and financial variance data to build clear, professional PowerPoint presentations for our management team and our customers.
Support Engineering Changes: Help the engineering team manage Engineering Change Notices (ECN), update risk assessments (PFMEA), and write simple, clear standard operating procedures (SOPs) for operators.

Education And Experience

Basic understanding of manufacturing cost structures, labor routing steps, material waste tracking, and cost variances (standard vs. actual).

Comfortable changing priorities quickly to help out where the plant needs it most.

7403(f)

Documentation and Reporting

Experience conducting field inspections and environmental monitoring activities

Job Description

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a leading integrated manufacturing solutions provider serving the fastest-growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. Recognized as a technology leader, Sanmina Corporation provides end-to-end manufacturing solutions, delivering superior quality and support to Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) primarily in the communications networks, defense and aerospace, industrial and semiconductor systems, medical, multimedia, computing and storage, automotive and clean technology sectors. Sanmina Corporation has facilities strategically located in key regions throughout the world.

Industrial Engineer/Project Coordinator

Job Purpose

Our Houston facility is looking for a practical, highly organized Industrial Engineer / Project Coordinator
to join our team during a major plant expansion. In this role, you will work directly with our Facilities Manager to coordinate equipment installations, track project timelines, and manage vendor schedules.

Because we are expanding, you will also act as a flexible engineering resource to help our Process and Manufacturing Engineers when workloads are high. Beyond physical facility coordination, this role focuses heavily on data analysis—tracking manufacturing costs, calculating floor efficiency, and identifying operational waste. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in facility planning, factory software systems, financial tracking, and project management.

Nature Of Duties

Track Equipment Installations: Work directly with equipment suppliers and contractors on the plant floor. Monitor delivery schedules, ensure utilities (power, air, etc.) are ready for setup, and track installation progress.
Manage Factory Software & Data: Use Oracle ERP and our Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to enter production routes, audit labor hours, and keep our manufacturing data accurate.
Conduct Time Studies & Costing: Spend time on the production floor timing assembly steps to compute cycle times. Use this data to help accounting establish accurate standard labor and machine costs.
Track Waste & Rework Costs: Collect and analyze data on scrap rates, material waste, and rework labor hours. Investigate the root causes of these variances to help the team reduce lost profitability on the floor.
Analyze Equipment Downtime & Capacity: Monitor machine utilization metrics through the MES. Categorize why machines stop (maintenance delays, slow setups, or waiting on parts) to help improve overall capacity.
Map Workflows & Material Flow: Create clear process flowcharts and value stream maps (VSM) using Microsoft Visio. Analyze material handling paths and operator travel times to minimize transit costs and prevent product damage.
Create Status Reports & Decks: Gather project updates, capacity metrics, and financial variance data to build clear, professional PowerPoint presentations for our management team and our customers.
Support Engineering Changes: Help the engineering team manage Engineering Change Notices (ECN), update risk assessments (PFMEA), and write simple, clear standard operating procedures (SOPs) for operators.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a similar technical field.
0–3 years of experience in a manufacturing or heavy assembly plant (internships or co-op experience count).
Basic understanding of manufacturing cost structures, labor routing steps, material waste tracking, and cost variances (standard vs. actual).
Ability to work well with different people, from shop-floor operators to external contractors and senior managers
Able to explain technical updates, project delays, and financial data clearly, both out loud and in writing.
Comfortable changing priorities quickly to help out where the plant needs it most.
